server.name: ng.ranked/ranked
server.description: Read-only tools over Ranked, a Nigerian business directory with dated regulator register snapshots

install.claudeCode: claude mcp add ranked --transport http https://ranked.ng/api/mcp

io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.longDescription: Ranked (ranked.ng) is a directory of Nigerian businesses. This server exposes nine read-only tools over it. Three read the production database: the ordered ranking for a category in a Nigerian city, served only where the base page is published; one place page with its rank on its primary published facet and any regulator register matches; and the indexable hub URLs on ranked.ng with counts. Six read committed files with no database: search across the file-backed dataset, whether a name appears on the CBN, SEC, NAICOM, NCC or PenCom register as accessed on a dated snapshot, a regulator's register in the regulator's own order, whether someone in Nigeria can pay for a named product (naira pricing, card acceptance, local rails, geo-restriction), the same rubric for two to five products side by side, and a stats tool reporting what the server holds and each register's access date. Every answer carries a canonical ranked.ng URL and an 'as accessed on' date. A register match is what that regulator's register listed on the access date, not a licence finding by Ranked. The server never writes, takes no payment, and returns no personal contact data.
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.title: Ranked

tools.description: Search Ranked's file-backed dataset of Nigerian-relevant businesses, institutions, websites and apps; every result carries url, source, source_url and accessed_on.
tools.name: ranked_find_business

tools.description: For a named product or service: naira pricing, whether a Nigerian-issued card is known to work, local rails, local entity, geo-restriction, the common workaround.
tools.name: ranked_can_nigerian_pay

tools.description: Whether a Nigerian business name appears on the CBN, SEC, NAICOM, NCC or PenCom register as accessed on the snapshot date, and under what licence class.
tools.name: ranked_check_licence

tools.description: Compare 2 to 5 named products on Nigeria-usability, in the order given.
tools.name: ranked_compare

tools.description: List a regulator's register as accessed, optionally filtered by licence-class text, in the regulator's own order.
tools.name: ranked_by_regulator

tools.description: What this server holds, by evidence tier and regulator, and its provenance rules.
tools.name: ranked_stats

tools.description: Ranked's ordered list for a category in a Nigerian city, from the production database, published pages only, with score breakdown and data_as_of.
tools.name: ranked_rankings

tools.description: One business listing by slug or by name and city, with its rank on its primary published facet and any register matches.
tools.name: ranked_place

tools.description: Indexable hub URLs on ranked.ng with counts: category, city, state and regulator-data hubs.
tools.name: ranked_hubs
